scripts.dev: bun run dev:clean && turbo run dev
scripts.setup: bun install && cd apps/serve && uv sync --all-groups && cd ../..
scripts.dev:clean: for port in 3000 8765; do pids=$(ss -ltnp 2>/dev/null | grep ":$port " | grep -oE "pid=[0-9]+" | cut -d= -f2 | sort -u); if [ -n "$pids" ]; then echo "cleaning orphan on :$port: $pids"; echo "$pids" | xargs -r kill 2>/dev/null || true; fi; done
